frases.dice: Going from four thousand to one hundred twenty-eight thousand tokens multiplies the text by thirty-two.
frases.muestra: Going from 4,096 to 131,072 tokens multiplies the text by 32.
frases.es: Pasar de 4.096 a 131.072 tokens multiplica el texto por 32.

frases.dice: And the cost of attention by one thousand twenty-four. That is why there is life beyond the dense Transformer.
frases.muestra: And the cost of attention by 1,024. That is why there is life beyond the dense Transformer.
frases.es: Y el costo de la atención, por 1.024. Por eso hay vida más allá del Transformer denso.

frases.dice: Tech capsule: beyond the dense Transformer.
frases.muestra: Tech capsule: beyond the dense Transformer.
frases.es: Cápsula técnica: más allá del Transformer denso.

frases.dice: Attention compares every token with every other one: n squared comparisons.
frases.muestra: Attention compares every token with every other one: n² comparisons.
frases.es: La atención compara cada token con todos los demás: n² comparaciones.

frases.dice: It also stores the keys and values of every token: the K V cache grows with the context.
frases.muestra: It also stores the keys and values of every token: the KV cache grows with the context.
frases.es: Además guarda las claves y los valores de cada token: la caché KV crece con el contexto.

frases.dice: And grouped query attention shares keys and values across several heads.
frases.muestra: Grouped-query attention (GQA) shares keys and values across several heads.
frases.es: La atención con consultas agrupadas (GQA) comparte claves y valores entre varias cabezas.

frases.dice: In a seventy billion parameter model, with eight groups instead of sixty-four heads, the cache per token drops from two point five to zero point three megabytes: eight times less.
frases.muestra: In a 70-billion-parameter model, with 8 groups instead of 64 heads, the cache per token drops from 2.5 to 0.31 MiB: 8× less.
frases.es: En un modelo de 70.000 millones, con 8 grupos en vez de 64 cabezas, la caché por token baja de 2,5 a 0,31 MiB: 8 veces menos.

frases.dice: A mixture of experts replaces one big network with several small ones, and a router picks which to use.
frases.muestra: A mixture of experts (MoE) replaces one big network with several small ones, and a router picks which to use.
frases.es: La mezcla de expertos (MoE) reemplaza una red grande por varias pequeñas, y un enrutador elige cuáles usar.

frases.dice: Mixtral has forty-seven billion parameters, but each token uses only thirteen: two experts out of eight.
frases.muestra: Mixtral has 47 billion parameters, but each token uses only 13: 2 experts out of 8.
frases.es: Mixtral tiene 47.000 millones de parámetros, pero cada token usa solo 13: 2 expertos de 8.

frases.dice: The idea dates back to nineteen ninety-one: a mixture model, where the output is the average of the experts, weighted by their probability.
frases.muestra: The idea dates back to 1991: a mixture model, where the output is the average of the experts weighted by their probability.
frases.es: La idea es de 1991: un modelo de mezcla, donde la salida es el promedio de los expertos ponderado por su probabilidad.

frases.dice: Today the router is a softmax: it keeps the top two, and a load balancing loss stops the same expert from always winning.
frases.muestra: Today the router is a softmax: it keeps the top 2, and a load-balancing loss stops the same expert from always winning.
frases.es: Hoy el enrutador es una softmax: se queda con los 2 más probables, y una pérdida de balance evita que gane siempre el mismo.

frases.dice: Linear attention changes the order of the multiplications: keys times values first, then the queries.
frases.muestra: Linear attention changes the order of the multiplications: keys times values first, then the queries.
frases.es: La atención lineal cambia el orden de las multiplicaciones: primero claves por valores y después las consultas.

frases.dice: The cost goes from n squared times d, to n times d squared: a Transformer that behaves like a recurrent network.
frases.muestra: The cost goes from n²·d to n·d²: a Transformer that behaves like a recurrent network.
frases.es: El costo pasa de n²·d a n·d²: un Transformer que se comporta como una red recurrente.

frases.dice: State space models summarize the whole past in a fixed-size state: the new h equals A times h, plus B times x.
frases.muestra: State space models (SSMs) summarize the whole past in a fixed-size state: hₜ = A·hₜ₋₁ + B·xₜ.
frases.es: Los modelos de espacio de estados (SSM) resumen todo el pasado en un estado de tamaño fijo: hₜ = A·hₜ₋₁ + B·xₜ.

frases.dice: They train in parallel like a convolution, and generate like a recurrent network: linear cost and constant memory.
frases.muestra: They train in parallel like a convolution and generate like a recurrent network: linear cost and constant memory.
frases.es: Entrenan en paralelo como una convolución y generan como una recurrente: costo lineal y memoria constante.

frases.dice: Mamba makes B, C and the step delta depend on the input: the model decides what to remember, and what to forget.
frases.muestra: Mamba makes B, C and the step Δ depend on the input: the model decides what to remember and what to forget.
frases.es: Mamba hace que B, C y el paso Δ dependan de la entrada: el modelo decide qué recordar y qué olvidar.

frases.dice: It reports up to five times higher inference throughput than a Transformer. And hybrids, like Jamba, mix both ideas.
frases.muestra: It reports up to 5× higher inference throughput than a Transformer. And hybrids, like Jamba, mix both ideas.
frases.es: Reporta hasta 5× más rendimiento en inferencia que un Transformer. Y los híbridos, como Jamba, mezclan las dos ideas.

frases.dice: On Google Cloud, Gemini one point five Pro is a mixture of experts Transformer. And large-scale mixture of experts grew up on T P Us: G Shard trained six hundred billion parameters on two thousand forty-eight T P Us.
frases.muestra: On Google Cloud, Gemini 1.5 Pro is a mixture-of-experts Transformer. And large-scale MoE grew up on TPUs: GShard trained 600 billion parameters on 2,048 TPUs.
frases.es: En Google Cloud, Gemini 1.5 Pro es un Transformer de mezcla de expertos. Y la MoE a gran escala creció sobre TPUs: GShard entrenó 600.000 millones de parámetros en 2.048 TPUs.

frases.dice: The basics: the quadratic cost of attention, the K V cache, softmax and mixture models, and linear recurrences.
frases.muestra: The basics: the quadratic cost of attention, the KV cache, softmax and mixture models, and linear recurrences.
frases.es: Las bases: el costo cuadrático de la atención, la caché KV, la softmax y los modelos de mezcla, y las recurrencias lineales.

frases.dice: If this helped, share and follow.
frases.muestra: If this helped, share and follow.
frases.es: Si te sirvió, compártelo y sígueme.
